Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 095. 最长公共子序列

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    int longestCommonSubsequence(string text1, string text2) {
        int m = text1.size(), n = text2.size();
        vector<vector<int>> f(m + 1, vector<int>(n + 1));
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (text1[i - 1] == text2[j - 1]) {
                    f[i][j] = f[i - 1][j - 1] + 1;
                } else {
                    f[i][j] = max(f[i - 1][j], f[i][j - 1]);
                }
            }
        }
        return f[m][n];
    }
};
